observations.body: Signed-out Login displays Username and Password fields, a Sign in button, and demo Employee, Manager, and HR Admin usernames.
Signing in as the configured Employee opened the Employee dashboard.

Employee Dashboard shows navigation to Directory, My Leave, Timesheet, and My Profile; quick actions Request leave and Fill timesheet; a Log out button; pending leave requests count 0; and a leave balance still loading as an ellipsis.

My Leave offers New request, reports Available balance 18 days with deduction on approval, and shows one approved Vacation history entry for Aug 18–19, 2026 with 3 days and manager comment “Approved – enjoy!”.

New Leave Request defaults Leave type to Vacation and offers Vacation, Sick, and Personal choices; requires Start date and End date; has optional Reason; states weekends are not counted; and provides Submit request and Cancel.
Blank required date fields are visible; a blank submission is being checked for validation and should not create evaluation data.
Submitting the blank leave form kept the Employee on New Leave Request and displayed “Please fill in all required fields.”
Timesheet shows a draft for week of Sep 14, 2026 with seven daily hour inputs all at 0, total 0 h, and Save draft and Submit week actions.
